query GetDemandGridData($warehouses: [String!]!, $schedules: [String!]!, $itemNumber: String!, $company: Float!, $user: String!) {
  getDemandOrderDetailsForMOs(
    warehouses: $warehouses
    schedules: $schedules
    itemNumber: $itemNumber
    company: $company
    user: $user
  ) {
    company
    startDate
    scheduleNumber
    materialItemNumber
    referenceOrderLine
    ooline {
      customersOrderNumber
      location
      requestedDeliveryDateWdz
      __typename
    }
    materialPlansForMOs {
      transactionQuantityBasicUM
      sumOfPreAllocatedQuantities
      sumOfRequestedQuantities
      orderNumber
      orderLine
      orderCategory
      preAllocationByOrderNumber {
        demandOrd
        demandOrdLine
        demandCategory
        par1
        par2
        supplyOrd
        supplyOrdLine
        priority
        supplyId
        demandId
        orderLine {
          customersOrderNumber
          location
          requestedDeliveryDateWdz
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  getDemandOrderDetailsForMOPs(
    warehouses: $warehouses
    schedules: $schedules
    itemNumber: $itemNumber
    company: $company
    user: $user
  ) {
    company
    startDate
    scheduleNumber
    materialItemNumber
    referenceOrderLine
    oolineByManufacturingOrder {
      customersOrderNumber
      location
      requestedDeliveryDateWdz
      __typename
    }
    materialPlansForMOPs {
      transactionQuantityBasicUM
      sumOfPreAllocatedQuantities
      sumOfRequestedQuantities
      orderNumber
      orderLine
      orderCategory
      preAllocationByOrderNumber {
        demandOrd
        demandOrdLine
        demandCategory
        par1
        par2
        supplyOrd
        supplyOrdLine
        priority
        supplyId
        demandId
        orderLine {
          customersOrderNumber
          location
          requestedDeliveryDateWdz
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  getDemandOrderDetailsForROs(
    warehouses: $warehouses
    schedules: $schedules
    itemNumber: $itemNumber
    company: $company
    user: $user
  ) {
    company
    transactionDate
    materialItemNumber
    referenceOrderNumber
    orderNumber
    doroLineItem {
      itemNumber
      orderNumber
      orderLineNumber
      transactionDate
      transactionQuantityBasicUM
      sumOfPreAllocatedQuantities
      sumOfRequestedQuantities
      orderNumber
      orderLineNumber
      demandByDoroLine {
        demandOrd
        demandOrdLine
        demandCategory
        par1
        par2
        priority
        supplyId
        demandId
        orderLine {
          customersOrderNumber
          location
          requestedDeliveryDateWdz
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
